properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Saturday, June 24, [1933], on stationery from the Metropole Hotel in Shanghai; includes description of the arrival of [Paul] Groeger, an auditor from Pan American Airways, and two Sikorsky aircraft with crew, as well as a brief update on the negotiations with the minister of communications [Chu Chia-hua]; mentions Miss Forbes.
